# Test fixtures

This directory holds the deterministic inputs and references read by the Rust
tests. **Fixtures are regenerated, not hand-edited.**

The CPU reference is C mVMC 1.4.0 (`extern/mVMC-1.4.0`, #682).
[C_REFERENCE_PROVENANCE.md](C_REFERENCE_PROVENANCE.md) labels every file that
records C source hashes as 1.4.0 or historical 1.3.0. C-derived expectations
are generated by the optional, standalone programs in `c_toolbox/` and
`scripts/check_*_c_parity.py`; each fixture directory's README records the
generator, its provenance and the reproduction commands. Normal Rust tests
read the checked-in files only and never compile, invoke or read `c_toolbox/`.

The historical Julia CPU outputs and goldens (PfaPack.jl, `calc_m_all`,
candidate/one-move/Metropolis/projection/RBM dumps, parser and kernel
expectations, SR prefix trajectories, the Linux and macOS ARM overlays) were
removed in #695. Their input files remain where tests still read them; for
example `pfapack/*.orig.txt` are the fixed skew-symmetric inputs of
`crates/pfapack/tests/fixed_matrix_identities.rs`.

The Julia GPU references (pin `7314015`, XORWOW contract) used by the resident
GPU tests live under `gpu/mvmc-gpu-cuda/tests/fixtures/`.

Each `pfapack/*.orig.txt` file has a few `key value` header lines, a blank
line, then one floating-point literal per column-major entry (`%.17e`; complex
rows print `re im`).
